interaction: Design a skateboard in a CSS 3D deck lab — pick popsicle, cruiser or old-school shape (with kicked nose and tail), one of six SVG stencil graphics, deck colour, grip tape style and wheel colour or deck-only — then drag to spin it, use arrow keys to rotate and tilt, or hit 'Flip it' to see grip versus graphic side while an itemised sample price updates live; shop decks on the wall load into the lab, a stylised spot map picks local skate spots, and a lesson request form ends in a demo-only state.
notes: Prices are samples; spots are described generally and the map is stylised, not to scale. The deck's nose and tail kicks are flat angled planes and the wheels are built from a few planes, so it is a stylised 3D model. Ordering and lesson requests are demo-only.
